name: Ness Garrow
bio: One of the Unmoored on Cindermoor's long steps, who came to the island on purpose because the fog is thickest there (fifties): a heather-brown cloak gone grey to the knee, hands black with wet cinder, a cinder-rake. She and hers put out the cressets on the road above them, and sit just past where a lit one's light reaches.
